Which of the given State recorded the lowest percentage increase of candidates from 2012 to 2016?
solution:
**Given:**

The number of candidates from five states for an interview from 2012 to 2016.

**Formula used:**

Percentage Increase = frac{{Value in 2016} - {Value in 2012}}{{Value in 2012}} × 100

**Calculations:**

Bihar: (500 - 410)/(410) times 100 approx 21.95\%

U.P.: (430 - 300)/(300) times 100 approx 43.33\%

M.P.: (540 - 250)/(250) times 100 = 116\%

Punjab: (350 - 280)/(280) times 100 = 25\%

Kerala: (420 - 440)/(440) times 100 = -4.55\% (decrease)

Kerala has a percentage decrease.

The lowest percentage increase of candidates from 2012 to 2016 is Bihar.

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
